June 2023 – September 2023

June 2022 – September 2022

- Maintained meticulous records of crop development and coordinated the safe storage and transportation of harvested produce.

KEY PROJECT
Mechanical Water Deterrent System (MWDS) — Final-Year Project 2026
- Designed and prototyped a hydraulic access-control deterrent specifically engineered for Computer-Based Testing (CBT) centres.
- Engineered a system utilising a high-pressure pump, 60A solid-state relays, and a BTS7960 high-power motor driver to control a targeted turret assembly.
- Achieved 238 kPa impact pressure at a 2.64 bar nozzle pressure with a 28 m pump head.
- Validated system efficacy, achieving a 100% detection rate within a 3.0 m range and a rapid 238.2 ms response time.
- Conducted thorough structural analysis, confirming an Euler buckling safety factor of ≈632 for the physical assembly.

LEADERSHIP & ACTIVITIES
